audit_items.explanation: This checklist item concerns ModExp gas calculation (EIP-7883), which is an Execution Layer (EL) concept. The target codebase is Nimbus-eth2, a Consensus Layer (CL) beacon chain client. ModExp precompile execution and gas calculation are handled by EL clients (e.g., nimbus-eth1), not CL clients.

This checklist item concerns EIP-7825 and EIP-7883 activation at Fusaka fork. While CL clients handle fork scheduling, the specific EIPs mentioned (TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT, ModExp gas) are EL transaction validation rules. The target codebase (Nimbus-eth2) is a CL client and does not implement EL transaction validation.

This checklist item concerns MEV-Boost relay validation of gas caps. MEV-Boost integration and block building validation are handled at the EL level. Nimbus-eth2 (CL client) interfaces with MEV-Boost for block proposals but does not validate EL gas cap constraints directly.

This checklist item concerns private channel transaction validation (Flashbots Protect). Transaction pool management and block validation for oversized transactions are EL responsibilities. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement transaction pool or EL block validation logic.

This checklist item concerns ceiling division in ModExp multiplication_complexity. This is EVM precompile gas metering logic implemented in EL clients. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not contain EVM execution or precompile implementations.
This checklist item concerns iteration_count calculation for ModExp exponents. This is EVM precompile gas calculation logic in EL clients. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EVM precompiles.
This checklist item concerns bit_length computation for large exponents in ModExp. This is EVM precompile logic in EL clients. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EVM precompiles.
This checklist item concerns integer-only arithmetic in ModExp gas computation. This is EVM precompile implementation detail in EL clients. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EVM execution.

This checklist item concerns gas cap validation on raw tx.gasLimit in txpool. Transaction pool implementation and gas limit validation are EL client responsibilities. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement transaction pool logic.
This checklist item concerns ModExp gas cost monotonicity. This is EVM precompile gas formula verification in EL clients. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EVM precompiles.
This checklist item concerns EIP-7883 vs EIP-2565 gas comparison. This is EVM precompile gas calculation in EL clients. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EVM precompiles.

This checklist item concerns ECDSA signature recovery for transaction sender derivation. Transaction signature validation is an EL responsibility. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) handles BLS signatures for consensus, not ECDSA for EL transactions.
This checklist item concerns ECDSA r-component range validation. Transaction signature validation is an EL responsibility. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) uses BLS signatures, not ECDSA for transaction validation.
This checklist item concerns EIP-2 low-s normalization for ECDSA. This is EL transaction signature validation. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement ECDSA transaction signature validation.

This checklist item concerns transaction type signing hash collision prevention. Transaction signing and type validation are EL responsibilities. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EL transaction type validation.
This checklist item concerns pre-EIP-155 cross-chain replay attacks. Transaction replay protection is an EL responsibility. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EL transaction validation.

This checklist item concerns EVM state snapshot deep-copy isolation. State management with copy_trie, _main_trie, _storage_tries is EL client architecture. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) has different state management for beacon state.
This checklist item concerns EVM state._snapshots count invariant. This is EL state management. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not use this EVM snapshot architecture.
This checklist item concerns commit_transaction snapshot decrement. This is EL EVM execution state management. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EVM execution.
This checklist item concerns created_accounts clearing at outermost snapshot. This is EL EVM state management for EIP-2200/EIP-6780. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EVM execution.
This checklist item concerns rollback_transaction restoring exact snapshot state. This is EL EVM execution state management. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EVM execution.
This checklist item concerns transient storage rollback (EIP-1153 TSTORE/TLOAD). This is EL EVM opcode implementation. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EVM opcodes.
This checklist item concerns persistent and transient snapshot stack synchronization. This is EL EVM state management. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EVM execution.
This checklist item concerns get_account returning EMPTY_ACCOUNT not None. This is EL state trie access. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EL account state management.
This checklist item concerns set_account(None) preserving storage. This is EL state trie management. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EL account storage.
This checklist item concerns destroy_account atomicity (EIP-6780 SELFDESTRUCT). This is EL EVM opcode implementation. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EVM opcodes.
This checklist item concerns destroy_storage double-deletion handling. This is EL state management for SELFDESTRUCT. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EL state management.
This checklist item concerns mark_account_created persistence across reverts. This is EL EVM state for CREATE/CREATE2. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EVM execution.
This checklist item concerns get_storage returning U256(0) for unset keys (SLOAD). This is EL EVM storage access. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EVM storage.
This checklist item concerns set_storage requiring account existence (SSTORE). This is EL EVM storage management. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EVM storage.
This checklist item concerns empty storage trie cleanup. This is EL state trie management. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EL storage tries.
This checklist item concerns storage_root blocking during active transaction. This is EL state root computation. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) computes different roots (beacon state root).
This checklist item concerns state_root incorporating all storage roots. This is EL state root computation. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not compute EL state roots.
This checklist item concerns account_has_storage checking key existence. This is EL storage trie management. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EL storage.
This checklist item concerns is_account_alive check (EIP-161). This is EL account liveness for empty account cleanup. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EL account management.
This checklist item concerns modify_state destroying empty accounts (EIP-161). This is EL state cleanup. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EL account management.
This checklist item concerns ether conservation in move_ether. This is EL value transfer logic. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EL value transfers.
This checklist item concerns move_ether balance sufficiency check. This is EL value transfer validation. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EL balance management.
This checklist item concerns increment_nonce increasing by exactly 1. This is EL account nonce management. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EL account nonces.
This checklist item concerns get_storage_original for created accounts (EIP-2200). This is EL gas accounting. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EL gas metering.
This checklist item concerns get_storage_original reading from outermost snapshot. This is EL EVM storage for EIP-2200 gas refunds. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EVM.
This checklist item concerns transient storage returning U256(0) for unset keys (EIP-1153 TLOAD). This is EL EVM opcode. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EVM.
This checklist item concerns transient storage transaction scoping (EIP-1153). This is EL EVM feature. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EVM.
This checklist item concerns empty transient storage trie cleanup. This is EL EVM memory management. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not implement EVM.
This checklist item concerns EIP-7623 gas validation. This is EL transaction validation. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not validate EL transactions.
This checklist item concerns EIP-2681 nonce overflow check. This is EL transaction validation. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not validate EL transaction nonces.
This checklist item concerns MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE enforcement. This is EL contract creation validation. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not validate EL contract creation.
This checklist item concerns EIP-7825 TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT enforcement. This is EL transaction validation. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not validate EL gas limits.
This checklist item concerns EIP-7623 calldata token counting. This is EL transaction gas calculation. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not calculate EL gas.
This checklist item concerns EIP-7623 calldata floor formula. This is EL transaction gas calculation. Nimbus-eth2 (CL) does not calculate EL gas.
